content.tex: This investigation looks at the number of winning lines on a grid.

parts.text: In a game you win by making a straight line of three s on a 3 by 3 grid. There are 8 winning lines of three s on a 3 by 3 grid. Show each winning line of three s on the grids. Three of the winning lines have been shown for you. [2]
